name: DarkPlaces (Xonotic engine)
use: Xonotic's engine, built in Dolly as the dedicated server and the SDL client

name: Xonotic game logic (qcsrc)
use: The QuakeC programs gmqcc compiles in Dolly; lib/warpzone is MIT or GPL-2.0-or-later and lib/csqcmodel MIT

name: libogg
use: Ogg container for Vorbis: the libogg package, linked into Xonotic's client and 0 A.D.'s engine

name: libvorbis
use: Vorbis audio decoding: the libvorbis package, the Ogg Vorbis sounds of Xonotic and 0 A.D.

name: Xonotic data
use: The release's data and maps archives, unmodified, GPL-3.0-or-later by Xonotic's COPYING (the pass over them is in docs/licences.md)

name: Xolonium
use: Xonotic's menu and HUD font: the 4.2 GPL variant the repository's xonotic/ directory builds; its source archive is served beside the image

name: GNU Unifont
use: Xonotic's fallback font for every script: GNU's 7.0.06 release, whose precompiled TTF is the shipped file; its source archive (.hex files and build scripts) is served beside the image
